audience: shops and fulfillment teams that ship parcels with Chit Chats

useCases.title: Track shipments in transit or with an exception
useCases.text: List shipments filtered by status, then open one to read its tracking code, carrier and label URLs.

useCases.title: Count shipments and pending batches
useCases.text: Count all shipments, then list the batches that are still pending or ready.

useCases.title: Review returned shipments and their reasons
useCases.text: List returned shipments by status and return reason.

useCases.title: Compare rates before buying postage
useCases.text: Create a shipment with postage type unknown to see its rates. The shipment stays unpaid. Buy postage in the Chit Chats dashboard.

useCases.title: Group shipments into a batch
useCases.text: Put shipments into a batch, or take them out again. Repeating the same call changes nothing.
